7. Inadequate security measures: Hackers may find weaknesses in security measures such as firewalls or intrusion detection systems. Regularly review and update security measures to ensure they are effective.

By understanding these tactics and implementing appropriate countermeasures, organizations can significantly reduce their vulnerability to hacking and protect their sensitive information.
